title: Interest Rate Schedule — Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
**Ridgeline Consumer Credit annual percentage rates and interest terms, by tier.** The purchase APR on a revolving card is the standard variable rate on purchases; on a Ridgeline Project Loan it is the fixed loan APR.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase APR (percent per year) | 32.24 | 29.99 | 26.99 | 7.99 | 7.99 | 7.99 |
| Days in the year for the daily periodic rate | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Minimum interest charge (USD) | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Grace period after the statement closing date (days) | 25 | 25 | 25 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. The days-in-the-year figure is the number the APR is spread over to give the daily periodic rate: the APR divided by 100 and by 365.
2. Minimum interest charge: when the interest computed for a statement period is above zero but below this amount, this amount is charged instead. A figure of 0.00 means the tier has no minimum interest charge.
3. Grace period: the number of days after the statement closing date by which paying the full statement balance avoids interest on new purchases. A figure of 0 means the tier has no grace period.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On Card Premier the daily periodic rate is 26.99 divided by 100 and by 365, about 0.0739 percent a day. On every Project Loan tier the same 7.99 percent fixed APR applies, with no grace period and no minimum interest charge.
